# Vahtian

> Citation-integrity infrastructure: a blinded human → AI → adjudication workflow for research citations, with decision-gated, undoable writes and a hash-chained audit trail. Free and local-first for researchers; paid infrastructure for organizations at publication scale. "vahti" is Finnish for *sentinel / guard*.

Vahtian records the blinded human → AI → adjudication workflow with provenance; it does not assert truth. Core principles: the human decides (AI is a blinded, advisory second rater, never decisive); no silent writes (references enter a library only as the audited, undoable last step, dedupe fails closed); the reasoning is recorded (a hash-chained audit trail reportable in a methods section); open core, local-first (the core is Apache-2.0 and runs on your machine). The free researcher tools are single-file and browser-only — nothing is uploaded.

## Products (live)
- [CiteVahti](https://vahtian.com/citevahti/): Verify the claim before you cite it, inline in your manuscript.
- [MatchVahti-Lite](https://vahtian.com/matchvahti-lite/): Tap the sentences worth citing in a PubMed abstract and append them to a reviewable Zotero `.ris` — provenance kept, nothing uploaded.
- [StudyVahti](https://vahtian.com/studyvahti/): Protocol-readiness for clinical study ideas — PICOTS structure, a variable codebook, and triage mapped to SPIRIT / STROBE / TRIPOD. Variables export into DictVahti.
- [DictVahti](https://vahtian.com/dictvahti/): REDCap data-dictionary linter — 26 deterministic checks across naming, field types, choices, branching logic and completeness, with one-click fixes.

## Roadmap
- ReviewVahti: Journals & editorial offices — claim-level checks, reviewer oversight, manuscript audit trails.
- GuidelineVahti: Guideline groups, societies, institutions & medical-communications teams.
- AtlasVahti: Consented, de-identified evidence-validation patterns — governed analytics & API.
